about.title: Nine-plus years turning designs into product.
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Engineer, born in Venezuela and based in Santiago, Chile. I specialize in front-end with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and today I also build full stack for PagerDuty, where I take on-call shifts to keep a product stable in production.

I've worked on financial platforms and high-traffic e-commerce: I rolled out Cencosud's in-store pickup kiosks to 56 stores across Chile and built internal libraries for LVA Indices' projects. Today AI is part of how I work: I build MCP servers, agents and Skills that automate the team's repetitive work.

specs.tail: Field-tested with Scrum, Kanban, Material‑UI, SASS and Bootstrap, alongside UX, design and backend teams.

jobs.description: I ship full stack features across two PagerDuty products, Catalytic and Rundeck, designing the interfaces and their component architecture. I keep Catalytic stable in production through 24/7 on-call shifts.
I've contributed to international products through Athenaworks (SoundExchange, Whitepages) and to Aurica, Chile's leading precious-metals broker, with React, Next.js and TypeScript.

Built financial platforms with React, Next.js and TypeScript. Alongside that, I created internal component and utility libraries for the company's projects, developed scrapers with Playwright, and brought AI into the team's workflow with an MCP server, agents and Skills.

Rolled out in-store pickup kiosks to 56 stores across Chile, from coding the ticket they print to monitoring every installation, with a test kiosk at my home. I also led the React + Redux migration that made the front-end ~35% faster.

jobs.role: Front-End Developer · Remote · contractor for Cencosud
jobs.description: Expanded the team's reusable component library with React and Material‑UI, integrating REST APIs. Cencosud later brought me in-house.

Turned client designs into responsive interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and Bootstrap, working with designers and project managers.
